I am 69, never went to school, and I have farmed this same 3.5 mu for 45 years. My son works in a factory in Handan and sends money home, but this land still feeds us. I grow wheat in winter and maize in summer on the same piece — always wheat first, then maize right after.

For wheat this year: I will sow in early October. I buy the improved seed from the shop in town, the kind everyone uses, about 15 jin per mu. Before sowing I spread one full bag of compound fertilizer on each mu — the 50kg bag with 15-15-15 printed on it. That costs about 100 yuan a bag. In March when the wheat turns green, I will topdress with half a bag of urea per mu, 25kg. Last year I put less urea and the wheat was yellow and thin, so I am not cutting back. Better to spend the money. I irrigate three times: once when it greens up, once when it shoots up tall, and once when the grain is filling. I spray twice: once for weeds right after sowing, and once in spring for the bugs that chew the leaves. I do rotary tillage before sowing, pay the machine 30 yuan per mu. I expect about 1000 jin per mu, that is 500kg, same as last year.

For maize: I plant right after wheat harvest in June. Hybrid seed, about 3 jin per mu. I put 40kg of compound fertilizer per mu at planting time, and when the maize is knee-high I put 30kg of urea per mu between the rows. I do not till for maize — I plant straight into the wheat stubble with the no-till machine. The stubble keeps the ground moist and I save 30 yuan per mu on tillage. I irrigate twice: once when it is tasseling, and once when the grain is filling. One spray for the corn borer and weeds together. I expect about 1100 jin per mu, that is 550kg.

Why these amounts? Because this is what I did last year and it was okay. I watch Old Zhang and the others on this road. They put one bag of compound on their wheat, so do I. If I use less and the yield drops, I lose hundreds of yuan. If I use a bit more fertilizer, I only lose a few tens of yuan. The math is simple. Fertilizer is expensive now, 3.5 mu is small, but I cannot afford a bad year. My family depends on it.
